import sys

# Read n and k from input
n, k = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize the memory of your friend
memory = []

# Initialize the set to keep track of distinct coffee varieties
distinct_varieties = set()

# Function to ask your friend to taste a cup of coffee
def ask_taste(café):
    sys.stdout.write(f"? {café}\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    response = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    return response

# Function to reset the memory of your friend
def reset_memory():
    sys.stdout.write("R\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()

# Main loop to determine the diversity of coffee varieties
for i in range(n):
    # Ask your friend to taste each café
    response = ask_taste(i + 1)
    memory.append(i + 1)
    
    # If the response is 'Y', add the café to the distinct varieties set
    if response == 'Y':
        distinct_varieties.add(i + 1)
    
    # If the memory size exceeds k, reset the memory
    if len(memory) > k:
        reset_memory()
        memory.pop(0)

# Output the diversity of coffee varieties
sys.stdout.write(f"! {len(distinct_varieties)}\n")
sys.stdout.flush()
